title: P28: §7.6 Uri is IdentifierUri
description: protocol-06 §7.6 defines struct Uri { opaque uri<V>; } with the same wire form as §5.2 IdentifierUri. Readings: (a) separate type that must be non-empty; (b) opaque, unchecked; (c) the same type. Chosen: (c) type alias Uri = IdentifierUri: empty means absent (e.g. no avatar), otherwise an RFC 3986 URI (consistent with P4 mimid-1wgh.5.19 and P12 mimid-1wgh.5.27).
